_about: Symbol animations for Night Drive (tools/sprites/symanim.py --game nd): what each symbol is, its backdrop, its idle loop and its win. Style: 1980s cartoon cel, flat two-tone shading, thick outlines.

driver.what: the cartoon bust of a confident woman getaway driver with big curly hair and pink aviator sunglasses
driver.idle: Her curly hair bounces softly, the sunset glints across her sunglasses, she gives a small cool smile.
driver.win: She pushes her sunglasses down with one finger and winks, her hair whips in a gust of wind, pink neon sparks fly around her.

captain.what: the cartoon bust of a grinning boat captain with a white cap, a grey beard and a gold chain
captain.idle: He chuckles, his shoulders bounce, the gold chain glints.
captain.win: He laughs out loud and tips his captain's cap, sea spray and cyan sparkles burst around him.

owner.what: the cartoon bust of a suave nightclub owner with slicked-back hair in a pastel pink blazer
owner.idle: He raises one eyebrow and smirks, adjusting his blazer collar.
owner.win: He snaps his fingers and grins, a shower of pink neon confetti and light flashes around him.

dj.what: the cartoon bust of a cool DJ with a glowing cyan visor and big headphones around his neck
dj.idle: He nods to a beat, the cyan visor pulses with light.
dj.win: He puts on his headphones and throws his head back laughing, pulsing cyan and pink sound waves ring out around him.

boat.what: a cartoon 1980s offshore speedboat with pink and cyan stripes cutting through a splash of water
boat.idle: The boat bobs on the water, little splashes spray from its bow.
boat.win: The boat jumps forward, a big wave of white spray bursts up around it, cyan sparkles in the spray.

tape.what: a cartoon retro cassette tape with a glowing pink label stripe
tape.idle: The tape reels turn slowly, the pink label glows softly.
tape.win: The reels spin fast, the cassette bounces, glowing pink and cyan music notes and sound waves burst out of it.

flamingo.what: a stylish cartoon pink flamingo with little sunglasses, standing on one leg
flamingo.idle: The flamingo shifts on its leg and preens a feather.
flamingo.win: The flamingo strikes a dance pose, flaps its wings, pink feathers and sparkles swirl around it.

briefcase.what: a cartoon shiny metal briefcase with cyan light glowing from its seams
briefcase.idle: The cyan glow at its seams pulses softly.
briefcase.win: The briefcase pops open a little and a burst of bright cyan light and sparkles shoots out.

shades.what: a pair of cartoon pink 1980s sunglasses with a sunset reflected in the lenses
shades.idle: A glint slides across the lenses.
shades.win: The sunglasses bounce up, a bright star glint flashes across both lenses, pink sparks pop around them.

skate.what: a single cartoon hot-pink roller skate with cyan wheels
skate.idle: The wheels spin slowly, the skate rocks a little.
skate.win: The skate does a little jump and spin, its wheels blur, a pink and cyan motion trail swooshes around it.

palm.what: a neon sign of a palm tree made of glowing pink and cyan tubes
palm.idle: The neon tubes hum and flicker softly, the fronds sway a little.
palm.win: The neon sign flickers fully on, blazes bright pink and cyan, a glow pulses out around it.

heart.what: a neon sign of a heart made of a glowing hot-pink tube with a cyan inner line
heart.idle: The neon heart beats softly, its glow pulsing.
heart.win: The neon heart beats strongly twice, flaring bright pink, little hearts and sparks pop out around it.

wild.what: an original cartoon retro-futuristic pink sports car with a glass bubble canopy, a glowing light bar at the front and tail fins, with pink and cyan light trails
wild.idle: The car's light bar pulses, the light trails behind it flow and shimmer, the car rocks slightly as if idling.
wild.win: The car revs and lurches forward, its light bar flashes bright, the pink and cyan light trails stream out long and fast, sparks fly.

scatter.what: a round emblem of a striped synthwave sun setting over the sea between two palms, in a chrome ring
scatter.idle: The sun's stripes shimmer, the sea glitters, the chrome ring glints.
scatter.win: The sun blazes up bright orange and pink, rays burst out from the emblem, the chrome ring flashes.
